title: dForge Roles
description: Role definitions with entity rights for a dForge module

rights.description: Security object → rights string. Keys are PREFIX-NAMESPACED so an action and an entity may share a code: a bare key is an entity code in this module ('invoice'), 'module.entity' is an entity owned by a module this one depends on ('parties.party'), 'action:<action_cd>' is an action from this module's ui/actions.json, and 'sp:<sp_cd>' is a stored procedure from logic/stored_procedures.json ('sp:module.sp_cd' for a dependency's), and 'report:<report_cd>' is a report from ui/reports.json ('report:module.report_cd' for a dependency's). A grant on an action written WITHOUT the 'action:' prefix is read as an entity code, resolves to nothing, and is silently dropped at install — action.execute then returns PERMISSION_DENIED.

additionalProperties.description: Rights: S=Select, I=Insert, U=Update, D=Delete, C=Clone, E=Execute. Entity objects take any of SIUDC; actions, stored procedures and reports take E.
